### problem_chain

**Root.** The member asks *"to put in as much prepay as the programme will carry against next spring's
fertilizer"*, is explicit that he wants *"whatever the programme will actually carry for him"* rather than a round
figure, and reserves the act to himself: *"the booking itself is his money and he will be the one to put it in"*.
That is the subject of `agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling`, whose rule opens *"A prepay booking taken against a
signed request the member has lodged is taken at the ceiling the programme will carry where the member has asked
for more than that, and the member books it in their own name."* Trigger `on_request`; target tool
`book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27`, `owner="user"`.

**Hop 1 (edge C).** The root's own rule carries *"The money the cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed
only after the account's ledger carries the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just
closed."* Is that state true at `2026-10-22`? The account's ledger carries exactly one `agronomy_discount_granted`
row, `7efe6db7-…`, and it is `discount_type: "prepay"`, `posted_date: "2025-11-05"`, written against booking
`BK-770882`. No volume discount for the crop year just closed (1 September 2025 – 31 August 2026) stands anywhere
on the account. **False at the opening.** Which write brings it about? `agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount` is the
only extended rule whose subject is `agronomy_discount_granted`, and `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557` is the
only tool creating such a row — it stamps `discount_type="volume"`. One reading. That policy's `prerequisite` is
`[]` and nothing in its rule waits on anything, so the walk terminates.

**Derived tree.**

```
agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling            (root; owner=user write)
  └─(value_input, gate prior_net_spend)─ agronomy_ext_season_volume_discount
```

n = 1 prerequisite problem; 1 `value_input` edge ≥ max(n − 1, 1) = 1; no cycle; **topological order**
`grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557`, then `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27`. Isomorphic to the tree the charter
declares.

**DB row evidence that the edge is false at the opening.** `agronomy_invoices.7efe6db7-8d98-4143-8a4b-55b0c9be80b2`
is the account's only discount row and carries `discount_type: "prepay"`, `discount_amount: 1240.0`,
`posted_date: "2025-11-05"`, `booking_reference: "BK-770882"` — a prepay discount on last autumn's booking, not
the volume discount on the closed crop year. No other `agronomy_discount_granted` row exists on the account.

**Per-edge load-bearing run** (my own recomputation on this world):

| edge skipped | scored value of the dependent write | with the edge honoured | bears weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C — skip `grant_season_volume_discount_*` | booking **233,729.01** | **228,137.43** | yes |

Mechanism: skipping step 1 removes a `−5,083.25` discount row, so `discounts_standing` moves from `−6,323.25` to
`−1,240.00`, `prior_net_spend` from `214,365.85` to `219,449.10`, `gross_ceiling` from `235,802.43` to
`241,394.01`, and the booking rises by 5,591.58.

**Parallel edges / terminal state.** None: the tree is a single edge, so no ordering ambiguity and no shared
balance, cap or dedup key is contended.

**No-wait argument.** Given above.

**The tool layer judges no prerequisite.** `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557` executes `ctx.make_id`, one
`ctx.find("agronomy_accounts", account_id=…)` for the `customer_id`, one `ctx.create` on `agronomy_invoices` with
`event_type="agronomy_discount_granted"`, `discount_type="volume"`, `amount=-value`, then returns a confirmation.
`book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` does the same shape, additionally deriving a `BK-` booking reference from its own
row id. Neither reads the other's rows, counts discounts, checks the booking window, checks
`agronomy_orders.order_status`, raises, errors or hints.

**One problem of the tree is the customer's own write.** The root is `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27`,
`@tool(owner="user", rw="write")`, handed over passively: *"When the booking is handed over for him to make he
makes it there and then in his own name and reads back the booking number that comes off it."*

### task_independent_derivation

**Now / wait / refuse: act now.** The booking window is open — Full Acre Input Financing carries
`prepay_booking_window_open_month_day: "10-01"` and `prepay_booking_window_close_month_day: "12-31"`, and
`NOW = 2026-10-22` is inside it — and the signed request is already approved. The member asks for none of the four
`POLICY_NOT_COVERED` routes the blueprint names for this desk.

**Identity.** `find_members(member_number="M-33082")` → `customers.c253ab5d-…`; then
`verify_member_identity(customer_id="c253ab5d-…", member_number="M-33082", phone_number="5150330926")` — both match
the profile, `matched = 2 ≥ 2`.

**Object.** One crop input account: `agronomy_accounts.5191ed92-c51a-4640-8d1c-0a168f12ac88`,
`variant_name: "Full Acre Input Financing Account"`, `account_number: "IA-330826"`, `status: "active"`,
`lien_on_file: true`, `acres_enrolled: 1540.0`, `credit_status: "approved"`, `opened_date: "2018-03-14"`,
`prepay_balance: 7665.0`. No ambiguity. Programme parameters that govern: `volume_discount_pct 1.5`,
`volume_discount_threshold_usd 150000.00`, `program_rebate_threshold_acres 500.0`,
`prepay_maximum_pct_of_prior_year 100.0`, `prepay_minimum_usd 10000.00`,
`prepay_transferable_between_categories true`.

**Authorisation boundary.** He authorises the desk's own book-keeping — *"they are welcome to sort out anything on
his account that wants sorting while they are in there"*, and *"Whatever the desk tells him it has had to put right
on the account before it can answer him he takes without argument"* — and reserves the booking to himself. That
matches `owner="agent"` on write 1 and `owner="user"` on write 2 exactly. He names no other work and closes on the
booking confirmation.

**Write 1 — `grant_season_volume_discount_cc5ed557`.** Handling moment: the opening world.

- Object: *"written against the last invoice raised on the account in that season"*, the season being the crop year
  just closed (1 September 2025 – 31 August 2026 under the base measure `agronomy_msr_season_input_spend`). The
  latest `agronomy_invoice_issued` row is `980ff7bd-…`, `invoice_number: "IN-4420488"`,
  `invoice_date: "2026-07-09"` — both the last of that crop year and the last of the fourteen-month window. Unique.
- `deliveries_count` = invoices inside fourteen statement months of 2026-10-22 → `IN-4408710` (2025-09-15, 13),
  `IN-4411355` (2025-10-20, 12), `IN-4414902` (2026-01-14, 9), `IN-4416238` (2026-03-02, 7), `IN-4417704`
  (2026-04-06, 6), `IN-4419118` (2026-05-11, 5), `IN-4419977` (2026-06-02, 4), `IN-4420488` (2026-07-09, 3) = **8**.
- `volume_rate_pct` — factor `steady_buying_discount_rate`. 8 ≥ 8 **and** `credit_status = "approved"` → tier 1 →
  **2.25 %**.
- `season_invoiced = 64,944.00 + 30,132.00 + 46,008.00 + 13,335.00 + 49,152.00 + 14,223.00 + 14,040.00 + 7,875.00
  = 239,709.00`; `season_credits = −3,335.94` (`620a39d8-…`, `agronomy_credit_memo_issued`,
  `posted_date: "2026-06-20"`, 4 months back); `season_spend = **236,373.06**`.
- `qualifying_spend` — factor `qualifying_spend_basis`. `2 × 150,000 = 300,000 > 236,373.06`, so tier 1 does not
  fire; `236,373.06 ≥ 150,000` **and** `lien_on_file = true` → tier 2 → the whole of the season spend less half the
  threshold = `RND(236,373.06 − 75,000.00, 2) = **161,373.06**`.
- `acre_bonus_pct` — factor `applied_acre_bonus`. `custom_service_plans.d50a522a-…` is `status: "active"` →
  `holds_field_plan = True`; the three `custom_application_completed` work orders (2026-03-20 / 2026-05-05 /
  2026-06-14) are all inside fourteen statement months → `applied_acres = 560 + 340 + 240 = 1,140.0 ≥
  program_rebate_threshold_acres = 500.0` → tier 1 → **0.5 %**.
- `uplift_pct` — factor `settlement_record_uplift`. Payments inside fourteen statement months: 2025-10-30,
  2025-12-04, 2026-02-18, 2026-04-28, 2026-05-20, 2026-08-12 → `payments_count = 6 ≥ 5`; of those,
  `9f2ce707-…` (2026-02-18) is `payment_method: "grain_settlement_transfer"` → `grain_transfer_count = 1 ≥ 1` →
  tier 1 → **0.4 %**.
- **`discount_amount = RND(161,373.06 × (2.25 + 0.5 + 0.4)/100, 2) = 5,083.25`**, written against `IN-4420488` —
  the three components combined into one rate before they are applied, exactly as the rule insists.

**Write 2 — `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27`** (`owner="user"`). Handling moment: after write 1.

- The ceiling applies rather than the member's own figure because *"the member has asked for more than that"*:
  `agronomy_orders.e800110d-….requested_amount = 250,000.0` against a ceiling that comes out below it, and the
  persona confirms *"he wrote a big round number on the form because he did not know what the rule was, and that
  whatever the programme will carry is what he wants"*.
- `open_months = MONTHS(2018-03-14, 2026-10-22) = 103 ≥ 36` and `acres_enrolled = 1540.0 ≥ 500.0` → factor
  `prior_season_spend_basis` tier 1 → the prior season spend is half of everything invoiced over twenty-six
  statement months, less every discount granted.
  `spend_two_season` = the twelve invoices from `IN-4395110` (2024-09-18, 25 months) through `IN-4420488` =
  `441,378.20`; `discounts_standing = −1,240.00 + (−5,083.25) = −6,323.25`;
  `prior_net_spend = RND(441,378.20/2 − 6,323.25, 2) = **214,365.85**`.
- `ceiling_share_pct` — factor `secured_buying_ceiling_share`. `lien_on_file = true` **and**
  `deliveries_count = 8 ≥ 8` → tier 1 → **120 %**.
- `arrears_cut_pct` — factor `arrears_ceiling_cut`. `223b0078-…` is an `agronomy_finance_charge_assessed` row
  `posted_date: "2026-04-20"`, inside fourteen statement months → `charges_count = 1`; `payments_count = 6 ≥ 1` →
  tier 1 → **10 %**.
- `net_share_pct = max(0, 120 − 10) = **110 %**`;
  `gross_ceiling = RND(214,365.85 × 110/100, 2) = **235,802.43**`.
- `offset_share_pct` — factor `standing_prepay_offset`. `prepay_taken = 31,000.00` (`018f885e-…`,
  `agronomy_prepay_booked`, 2025-11-05); `prepay_drawn = −13,335.00 + (−10,000.00) = −23,335.00`
  (`35b8c255-…` and `3fe5053c-…`, both `agronomy_prepay_applied`); `prepay_standing = **7,665.00**`, which agrees
  with `agronomy_accounts.5191ed92-….prepay_balance = 7665.0`. Since it is > 0 **and**
  `prepay_transferable_between_categories = true` on this programme → tier 1 → **100 %**.
- **`booking_amount = RND(max(10,000.00, 235,802.43 − RND(7,665.00 × 100/100, 2)), 2) = 228,137.43`**, the
  programme minimum not biting.
- Other arguments: `account_id = "5191ed92-c51a-4640-8d1c-0a168f12ac88"`;
  `order_id = "e800110d-924d-4641-99ba-4fd4d27f5824"` (the only lodged agronomy request for this member, which the
  desk must find on its own side — *"he has no notion what number the desk gave it and they will have to find it on
  their own side"*); `product_name = "Spring Anhydrous Ammonia and UAN 32 Percent"` **verbatim** from the member's
  own words, which the tool's Verbatim class demands and the persona supplies word for word, with the follow-up
  *"If he is asked whether he wants it split across two classes he says no, one line will do"* fixing it at one
  line.

**Root problem's contrasting number on the opening world.** With the volume discount not written, the booking comes
out at **233,729.01** instead of **228,137.43**. The latter is the right one because the root's own rule fixes its
moment — *"The money the cooperative will take on a prepay booking is fixed only after the account's ledger carries
the volume discount earned on the input spend of the crop year just closed."*

**Terminal state.** `agronomy_invoices` gains two rows on account `5191ed92-…`: a volume discount of `−5,083.25`
against `IN-4420488`, and a prepay booking of `+228,137.43` under a freshly raised `BK-` reference against
"Spring Anhydrous Ammonia and UAN 32 Percent". `input_receivable` falls by 5,083.25 (from
24,010.00 to 18,926.75) and `prepay_credit` rises by 228,137.43 (from 7,665.00 to 235,802.43). No holding status
changes.

**Context closure.** Every input is reachable: `find_members` → `verify_member_identity` →
`find_agronomy_accounts(customer_id=…)` (variant, status, credit_status, lien_on_file, acres_enrolled,
opened_date, prepay_balance) → `find_agronomy_invoices(account_id=…)` (every ledger row, including the payment
methods) → `find_agronomy_orders(customer_id=…)` (the signed prepay request and its `order_id`) →
`find_custom_service_plans(customer_id=…)` and `find_custom_workorders(customer_id=…)`. Every value the member must
supply has a definite answer in the persona: the product wording, the refusal to split across classes, the fact
that he asked for more than the ceiling, and his refusal to guess the season's spend (*"the desk had better read it
off the record rather than take his guess"*). No field is visible only in the raw seed; the simulator improvises
nothing and supplies no policy judgement, calculation or correction.

**Base provisions checked against this world and cleared.** `agronomy_prepay_program` booking window: open
(10-01 … 12-31, `NOW = 2026-10-22`). Forfeiture: the standing 7,665.00 comes from a booking taken 2025-11-05, and
`prepay_forfeiture_after_months = 24` counted from the close of that window (2025-12-31) runs to 2027-12-31, so
nothing is forfeited. `agronomy_agg_multi_holding`: one open account, inside the max of two.
`agronomy_discount_schedule` stacking: Full Acre carries `prepay_then_volume_additive`, and the existing prepay
discount plus the new volume discount stand additively, so no best-single conflict.

**Minor persona↔record discrepancy, recorded as an observation.** The member says he dropped the signed form *"at
the Kellerton counter on Monday"*; the record shows `requested_date: "2026-10-20"` and
`received_at: "2026-10-20 14:05:00 CDT"`, which is a **Tuesday** (Monday was 2026-10-19). It is not an
authoritative fact the derivation consumes — the `order_id` is found by member, not by date, and only one agronomy
request exists for this member — so no ambiguity in the scored solution follows.

### factor_weight

Recomputed on this task's handling-time worlds; every substitution replays every other step unchanged.

**Computation 1 — `discount_amount` (gold 5,083.25; whole baseline 1,295.60).**

| factor | label | honest? | tier taken and the rows that put him there | baseline from `baseline.rule` | value under that baseline | bears weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steady_buying_discount_rate` | parameter | rate (2.25 / 1.9 / 1.5) ✓ | tier 1: `deliveries_count = 8` from the eight invoice rows inside fourteen statement months, **and** `credit_status = "approved"` | `P('volume_discount_pct') = 1.5` = "the rate the programme carries" ✓ | **3,872.95** | **yes** |
| `qualifying_spend_basis` | method | changes which aggregate the rate acts on ✓ | tier 2: `season_spend = 236,373.06 ≥ 150,000` but `< 300,000`, **and** `lien_on_file = true` → 236,373.06 − 75,000.00 | `MX(0, RND(season_spend − P('volume_discount_threshold_usd'), 2)) = 86,373.06` = "the part of the season spend above the programme's volume discount threshold" ✓ | **2,720.75** | **yes** |
| `applied_acre_bonus` | parameter | rate addend (0.5 / 0.25 / 0) ✓ | tier 1: `custom_service_plans.d50a522a-…` `status="active"` **and** `applied_acres = 1,140.0 ≥ 500.0` from three `custom_workorders` rows | `K('acre_bonus_none_pct') = 0.0` = "The applied acre bonus added to the rate is nil" ✓ | **4,276.39** | **yes** |
| `settlement_record_uplift` | parameter | rate addend (0.4 / 0.2 / 0) ✓ | tier 1: `payments_count = 6 ≥ 5` **and** `grain_transfer_count = 1` from `9f2ce707-…` (`grain_settlement_transfer`, 2026-02-18) | `K('uplift_none_pct') = 0.0` ✓ | **4,437.76** | **yes** |

Counts: 4 factors (inside 4–6), 3 `parameter` ≥ 2, 1 `method` ≥ 1. Every tier beyond the fall-through is a
conjunction over distinct records, so all four are multi-source. Cross-difficulty: `applied_acre_bonus` → `custom`;
the rows are seeded (`custom_service_plans` 1, `custom_workorders` 3) and agree with `products/custom.yaml`
("Variable Rate Prescription Plan" is a declared variant, `custom_application_completed` a declared event, and the
plan's `acres_applied: 1140.0` equals 560 + 340 + 240). See **OBS-9** on `custom` being a category without a
difficulty of its own.
Baseline alone: **1,295.60**, definite and ≠ gold.
No stamp names a tier outcome: nothing on any row reads "steady", "top rate" or an acre band; the tiers are reached
through counts, sums and a date window.
**Near-miss** for this computation: `agronomy_invoices.1ebcb735-…`, `IN-4403875`, `invoice_date: "2025-06-03"`,
`amount: 12157.2` — a careless reader sweeps it into the season spend along with everything else on the account,
pushing `season_spend` to 248,530.26 and the discount to 5,466.20. The rule excludes it by the window alone:
*"everything invoiced to the account over the **fourteen statement months** before the handling date"*, and
2025-06-03 is sixteen statement months back. A second one: `e3c52f35-…`, a `grain_settlement_transfer` payment of
2025-05-12, seventeen months back, which a careless reader counts toward both `payments_count` and
`grain_transfer_count`.

**Computation 2 — `booking_amount` (gold 228,137.43; whole baseline 233,385.75).**

| factor | label | honest? | tier taken and the rows that put him there | baseline from `baseline.rule` | value under that baseline | bears weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `secured_buying_ceiling_share` | parameter | share (120 / 105 / 100) ✓ | tier 1: `lien_on_file = true` **and** `deliveries_count = 8 ≥ 8` | `P('prepay_maximum_pct_of_prior_year') = 100.0` = "the share of the prior season spend the programme will carry as prepay" ✓ | **185,264.27** | **yes** |
| `prior_season_spend_basis` | method | changes which aggregate is measured ✓ | tier 1: `open_months = 103 ≥ 36` **and** `acres_enrolled = 1540.0 ≥ 500.0` → half the twenty-six-month total | `RND(spend_recent + discounts_standing, 2) = 233,385.75` = "everything invoiced to the account over the fourteen statement months before the handling date, less every discount granted" ✓ | **249,059.33** | **yes** |
| `standing_prepay_offset` | parameter | share (100 / 50 / 0) ✓ | tier 1: `prepay_standing = 7,665.00 > 0` **and** `prepay_transferable_between_categories = true` | `K('offset_none_pct') = 0.0` ✓ | **235,802.43** | **yes** |
| `arrears_ceiling_cut` | parameter | share (10 / 25 / 0) ✓ | tier 1: `charges_count = 1` from `223b0078-…` (2026-04-20) **and** `payments_count = 6` | `K('arrears_cut_none_pct') = 0.0` ✓ | **249,574.02** | **yes** |

Counts: 4 factors, 3 `parameter`, 1 `method`. Multi-source: `secured_buying_ceiling_share` (a holding field and an
invoice-history count), `prior_season_spend_basis` (an account age and an enrolled-acre figure),
`arrears_ceiling_cut` (charge rows and payment rows). Cross-difficulty on this policy: none declared and none
used — the task's cross-category floor is carried by `applied_acre_bonus` on computation 1.
Baseline alone: **233,385.75**, definite and ≠ gold.
**Stamp check.** `agronomy_accounts.5191ed92-….prepay_balance = 7665.0` equals `prepay_standing` exactly, so an
agent can read that binding off the holding instead of aggregating `agronomy_prepay_booked` less
`agronomy_prepay_applied`. It is a legitimate current-state field of the holding (the charter's
`binding.quantity_fields.prepay_balance = prepay_credit`) and it does **not** name the ladder's outcome — the tier
is chosen by `prepay_standing > 0` together with the programme's transferability flag, and no field reads
"transferable offset". Recorded as an observation, not a stamp defect.
**Near-miss** for this computation: `agronomy_invoices.35b8c255-…` and `3fe5053c-…`, the two
`agronomy_prepay_applied` drawdowns of −13,335.00 and −10,000.00 — a careless reader takes "the prepay already
standing to the member's credit" as the 31,000.00 booked and offsets that, dropping the booking to 204,802.43. The
rule excludes them by requiring what **stands** to the member's credit, which the base charter defines as

## findings

No red light in this task. Observations, each recorded in full in
`env/env_0003_farm_supply_and_grain_cooperative/audits/policy_task/crop_input_desk/_difficulty.md` § `findings` and given
its consequence against this world above:

- **OBS-5** — `program_rebate_threshold_acres` measures **enrolled** acres in base `agronomy_discount_schedule`
  ("once the enrolled acres reach the rebate threshold") and **applied** acres in `applied_acre_bonus` ("the acres
  the cooperative applied for them"). On this world both readings clear the threshold anyway — `acres_enrolled =
  1540.0` and `applied_acres = 1140.0` are both ≥ 500.0 — so the tier and the scored 5,083.25 are unaffected. The
  base programme rebate of `program_rebate_pct = 1.0` is written by no task tool and is not a scored quantity.
- **OBS-6** — base `agronomy_prepay_program` says *"The booking locks the price of the product it names"* and the
  base event `agronomy_prepay_booked` carries `unit_price` and `quantity`, but
  `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` takes neither and writes neither, so the row it lands
  (`booking_reference`, `product_name`, `amount`, `invoice_date`, `posted_date`) carries no locked price for a
  later drawdown to price against. Not a scored quantity here; the existing booking `BK-770882` in the seed does
  carry `unit_price: 310.0`, so the gap is in the tool contract rather than in the world.
- **OBS-9** — this task's only cross-category factor, `applied_acre_bonus`, reads `custom`, a product category
  that `blueprint.yaml` gives no difficulty of its own (the five difficulties are grain, storage, agronomy,
  patronage and energy). The rows it reads are seeded and charter-consistent, and `check_extended`'s operative
  test is "another category's holding or ledger", which `custom` satisfies; but nothing in task 1 reads records
  belonging to another *difficulty*, whereas task 0 reads three (`storage`, `grain`, `patronage`).
- **Prepay-balance stamp note** — `agronomy_accounts.5191ed92-….prepay_balance = 7665.0` equals the
  `prepay_standing` binding exactly, so that binding can be read off the holding rather than aggregated from
  `agronomy_prepay_booked` less `agronomy_prepay_applied`. It is a declared current-state field of the holding
  (`binding.quantity_fields.prepay_balance = prepay_credit`) and names no ladder outcome, so it is not a tier read
  off a stamp; it does make one of the four bindings of `standing_prepay_offset` available without the aggregate.
- **Persona↔record discrepancy** — the member says he lodged the signed form "on Monday" while
  `agronomy_orders.e800110d-…` records `2026-10-20`, a Tuesday. Not an authoritative fact the derivation consumes,
  and only one agronomy request exists for this member, so the `order_id` argument is still uniquely determined.

**RED-1** (`_difficulty.md` § `findings`) concerns `agronomy_ext_arrears_service_charge`, which this task does not
claim; it bears on task 0 only.

No other problem was found in this task: the two writes, their owners, their order, every argument, the terminal
state and all 12 revealed figures agree item for item with the derivation frozen above.

delivery leaves the plant."* It names and supersedes the sentence that says otherwise in base
`agronomy_prepay_program`, but the identical provision in base `agronomy_evt_invoicing` — *"Product is priced at
the list price in force on the day of delivery, except where the line draws against a prepay booking, which prices
at the booked price however the list has moved."* — is in neither `base_policy_refs` nor any `overwrite`, and still
says the opposite.

inherited base clause a ton of anhydrous drawn against the new booking bills at the price the booking locked;
under the extended clause the booking locks nothing and the ton bills at the list in force on the delivery day.

which governs. **It does not move this task's scored figures**: `book_prepay_commitment_189dfe27` writes no
`unit_price`, no drawdown is scored here, and my independent re-derivation below still reproduces GT on every

patronage rows.

## revision_7 — the change, and why it is the right direction

The render layer declined to sign "nothing rests on a reader seeing a binding" because
`agronomy_ext_prepay_booking_ceiling`'s prior-spend sentence said "less every discount granted on the account"
while the account's credit memo carries a `discount_amount` field of its own. A reader who took that field as a
discount would compute **227,728.41** instead of **228,136.14**, and the corpus ruled it out by inference across
three documents rather than by a sentence.

**I checked the binding before the prose, because the direction of the fix turns on it.** `discounts_standing` is
`SUM('agronomy_invoices','amount', event_type='agronomy_discount_granted')`. On this task's world:

| row | `event_type` | `discount_amount` | `amount` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `7efe6db7-…` (`BK-770882`) | `agronomy_discount_granted` | 1,240.00 | **−1,240.00** |
| the volume discount the agent writes | `agronomy_discount_granted` | 5,083.25 | **−5,083.25** |
| `620a39d8-…` (`IN-4419118`) | **`agronomy_credit_memo_issued`** | 370.66 | −3,335.94 |

The credit memo is excluded twice over — it belongs to a different `event_type` family, and its 370.66 sits in a
field this binding does not read. So the misreading is genuinely wrong and the sentence was moved to the binding,
not the binding to the sentence. **Had the binding admitted the credit memo, the correct fix would have been the
opposite one**; it does not. I reproduced the misreading end to end to confirm it is the reading the new sentence
closes: `−6,323.25 − 370.66 = −6,693.91` → `prior_net_spend 213,994.01` → `gross_ceiling 235,393.41` → booking
**227,728.41**, exactly the render layer's figure.

**The sentence says what the binding does and nothing more.** *"as a discount line of its own"* is the row-kind
restriction, i.e. the `event_type` filter; *"an early pay, volume, prepay or programme rebate discount"* is the
complete `discount_type` enum minus its null value, so it neither narrows nor widens what the binding sums; and
*"never the restocking charge withheld inside a credit memo"* is the frozen base charter's own gloss for
`agronomy_credit_memo_issued.discount_amount`. No window, date field, sign convention or condition is added.

**It reaches a reader of either document**: the qualification sits in `baseline.rule` (the computation document)
and in all three `method` texts of `prior_season_spend_basis` (that factor's document), as well as in the policy
`rule` and five `compute_basis` entries — ten distinct places, fourteen occurrences, all inside this one policy.
Every `compute_basis` sentence is still a verbatim substring of its own `rule`: zero misses across the charter.

Percent"`, `owner=user`. Both match GT and both are unchanged.
